name: io.github.tonyyang0504/dingtalk-mcp
description: DingTalk (钉钉) (messaging): send. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_DINGTALK_APP_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Client ID (formerly AppKey) of the internal enterprise app that owns the robot; exchanged at POST https://api.dingtalk.com/v1.0/oauth2/accessToken for a 7200-second accessToken.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_DINGTALK_APP_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Client Secret (formerly AppSecret) of the same app (developer console, 凭证与基础信息).

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_DINGTALK_ROBOT_CODE
environmentVariables.description: robotCode of the internal-app robot (developer console robot page; usually equals the app key).
